parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. This parameter takes effect only for diagnostic metrics that do not need to be assessed by running Cloud Assistant commands in guest operating systems.

parameters.name: MetricSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the diagnostic metric set. If this parameter is left empty, the dms-instancedefault set is used, which is the default diagnostic metric set provided for Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the security group. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. This parameter takes effect only for diagnostic metrics that do not need to be assessed by running Cloud Assistant commands in guest operating systems.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-diagnostic-report --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id i-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --metric-set-id dms-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --start-time 2022-07-11T12:00Z --end-time 2022-07-11T14:00Z --additional-options key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
